provenance: Original procedural mesh assemblies and deterministic pixel clusters, with explicit reuse of the authored Heath cottage, witness and primitive/material families. Generated Act2 boards supply shape, costume, period-material and composition references only; no concept-board crop, atlas cell, caption or stock pixels are imported.

requirements.source_event: E12 river-street evacuation, E13 lock/confluence and E14 human artillery bringing down a fighting machine; compact dry-ground game adaptation rather than a literal geographic survey
requirements.exclusions: No swimming, planks, boat control, falling death, blocking crowds, escort HP, extra boss, intact church spire, coastal Thunder Child sequence or microbial-ending cause. Scenery adds no attack cue or actionable prop cue.

api.build: static build(parent: Node3D) -> Dictionary: creates WeybridgeSceneryKit and returns root:Node3D, witnesses:Array[Node3D], collapse:Node3D; derives initial arrival/0 and hidden collapse/0
api.set_tableau: static set_tableau(kit: Dictionary, state: String, progress: float = 0.0) -> void: clamps finite supplied progress, delegates unchanged Heath.set_tableau, preserves six existing costumes and feet pivots
api.set_collapse: static set_collapse(kit: Dictionary, visible: bool, progress: float = 0.0) -> void: clamps finite supplied progress and reconstructs tripod pose, fragment translation/rotation, steam pose/alpha and linked gun recoil/flash, including reverse progress and fresh restore
api.ownership: Level owns the simulation clock, scenic start fields, snapshots, visibility decisions, terrain collision, encounters, giant-foot mechanism/visual, Salvage Handler, progression, trigger and cleanup. Kit contains no process callback, timer, collider, physics body, Area3D, actor group, AI, scheduler, equipment, ability or gameplay damage.

resource_policy.generation: Fixed hand-authored assembly dimensions and deterministic integer pixel-cluster formulas; no RNG stream, wall clock, shader TIME or delta integration
resource_policy.heath_reuse: scripts/acts/act2/heath_kit.gd: _cottage, _witness, set_tableau, _plane, _box, _cylinder, _torus, _sphere, _branch and _material; shared primitive meshes, costume textures and static materials are immutable
resource_policy.surface_cache: Three immutable original 64x64 nearest-filtered texture/material families, paving/water/earth; every plane receives its own duplicate with size-derived UV scale at 1.44 world units per repeat
resource_policy.animated_materials: Seven owned alpha-material duplicates: one field-gun flash and six steam puffs. Animation changes only these owned materials, never the Heath cache. Four fragments reuse static metal materials.
resource_policy.optional_cutaway: Sixteen LowQuayCurb meshes, two FarCourtyardPier bodies and two CourtyardPierCoping meshes register root-relative paths in optional_cutaway_paths and weybridge_cutaway_candidate metadata (20 total). The kit does not fade them. Any level-owned derived fade must first duplicate the effective material; cached Heath materials remain immutable.
resource_policy.native_scale: Procedural mesh dimensions are world units, with mesh vertices/UVs authored independently of concept-board resolution. Surface native textures are 64x64/1.44-world-unit repeat. Witness native textures remain 48x64 at .0225 world units per pixel.
